ns2:section.sectionText: In this course, students will examine and learn how "places" use media, geography, people, history, business, culture, and sports to brand themselves in the context of a global marketplace - with a particular focus on tourism experiences. Students will travel to London, England & Edinburgh, Scotland for the field study portion from 5/19/14 to 5/29/14. Registration requires permission of instructor. Applications available at http://studyabroad.illinois.edu. Please Note: Students must register through the Study Abroad office.
